ayahs.translation: By the Dawn
And ten nights
And the Even and the Odd
And the night when it departeth

ayahs.text: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
ayahs.translation: There surely is an oath for thinking man

ayahs.text: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
ayahs.translation: Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A'ad
With many-columned Iram

ayahs.text: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
ayahs.translation: The like of which was not created in the lands
And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley
And with Pharaoh, firm of might
Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands
And multiplied iniquity therein
Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment
Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful

ayahs.text: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
ayahs.translation: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me

ayahs.text: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
ayahs.translation: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me
Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan
And urge not on the feeding of the poor
And ye devour heritages with devouring greed
And love wealth with abounding love

ayahs.text: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
ayahs.translation: Nay, but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding
And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank

ayahs.text: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
ayahs.translation: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)
He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life
None punisheth as He will punish on that day
None bindeth as He then will bind
But ah! thou soul at peace
Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure
Enter thou among My bondmen
Enter thou My Garden
